title: Tenma Saki — What I Want From A Leader?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: What I Want From A Leader?（2★）

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, nice work!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you all as well, Luka.
Our practice went as well as it did because of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem to be getting the hang of leading the band, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's right♪ You seem a lot more confident.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, something's different... Maybe you have a different look on your face compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
If that's true, I'm very glad.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, it is kinda weird to think that your band was leaderless this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so? It didn't seem necessary to me since they all work so hard together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Fair point. Having a leader stand above everyone else may've had some negative side effects because you're all so close.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, even if that person was doing what they could for the band?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I suppose you girls might see it that way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But there is the possibility that one of you suddenly being placed in a position of power could cause problems since you've all been equals until now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Being asked to do something by the leader may cause you to become irritated with them and result in you refusing to listen to their commands...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, the more you care about the quality of your music and performances, the more likely it is for a band to argue and fight.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that sense, this was probably the most opportune time for you to choose your leader.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you'd just figured out what your aspirations are as members of Leo/need, and what you want to accomplish as a band.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And your manager saw that as the best moment for you to pick a leader. I have to say, that was very clever of him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So, does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we tried to do this sooner, then we might've ended up with someone else leading us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That might've been you when we all decided to go pro together, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. You were the one who taught us everything we needed to know about how to actually go pro as musicians.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That reminds me of how you picked a fight with Saku to protect us♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did that purely out of anger...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The leader should be the one stopping anything like that from happening.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Good point.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, wouldn't that make Ichika a solid possibility?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Why me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you've been willing to be the first to dive in during some crucial moments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, she's right! You were the one who said we should form a band and play Miku songs together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, you restarted the band with me when I started coming to school again!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you suggested it first...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, Ichika, we wouldn't be standing here right now if you hadn't taken action.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hearing that makes me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what about me?
In a different universe, I might've been leading us♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Pretty sure wishing for it disqualifies you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You don't think that, right, Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, since you've been a powerful source of encouragement. Your cheerful optimism has helped us get through more than a few tough situations.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only that, you and Ichika are both doing a wonderful job of telling everyone what Leo/need is all about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, Ichi, you next! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh... Basically the same things Honami and Luka just said...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. As the leader, Saki, you shouldn't needlessly put pressure on your fellow bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, this is a way of practicing how to see the best in others!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's good and all, but has everyone been making sure to get hydrated?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, we should wipe off all this sweat before we begin to cool down too much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In the end, the person that's meant to lead us is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona♪
